title: Implement edit page layout (/edit/[slug])
description: Implement the edit page layout for the visual editor at /edit/[slug]. This is a split-pane view: left panel for editing controls, right panel for the live preview. Client component.
acceptanceCriteria: Left panel contains the section list, palette picker, and edit controls
Right panel shows the live landing page preview (re-renders as edits are made)
Page loads with current page_data from the DB
Changes are reflected in the right panel in real-time
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component. Fetch prospect via GET /api/prospects/[slug] on mount. Store page_data in state. Render a two-column layout: 340px left panel + flex-1 right panel.
Left panel contains: BusinessInfoEditor (TASK-83), PalettePicker (TASK-81), SectionListPanel (TASK-80), ContentEditorDrawer trigger (TASK-82), ExportButton (TASK-84). Stack vertically with scroll.

Right panel: a scaled/scrollable rendering of the landing page using SectionRenderer, driven by the current page_data state. Updates on every state change (no debounce needed for palette; debounce 500ms for text edits).
Debounce page_data state changes by 1500ms. On change, PATCH /api/prospects/[slug] with updated page_data. Show a small 'Saved' indicator in the top bar.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify split-pane layout. Verify right panel shows the landing page.
